title: Early Anthropic hire, former METR COO have found a way to rein in rogue AI agents
slides: Can rogue AI agents be tamed? These founders think so.
Early Anthropic hire and ex-METR COO team up.
Their method predicts misbehavior before it happens.
You can now pressure-test your AI agents.
Test one agent this week; don't wait for a crisis.
thread_text:
1. Can rogue AI be tamed?

Ex-Anthropic hire and former METR COO just teamed up. They claim they can predict an AI agent's misbehavior before it happens.

2. The method: forecast misbehavior

Instead of reacting to failures, they pressure-test agents in advance. You simulate risky scenarios to see what breaks.

3. Pressure-test your agents now

You can already run these tests on your own AI agents. Early detection prevents costly failures and builds trust.

4. Don't wait for a crisis

Start testing one agent this week. The tools are available—no need to wait for a major incident.

5. Test one agent today

Pick a single agent, run a pressure test, and see what you find. If you haven't done it, start there.
